Class Property<T>

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.structures.properties.Property<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the value of the property.
All Implemented Interfaces:
IKeyed
public final class Property<T> extends Object implements IKeyed
Represents a property of a structure.

Several properties are predefined in this class. For example, the OPEN_STATUS property is used to represent whether a structure is open or closed.

  • Method Details

    • builder

      public static <U> Property.PropertyBuilder<U> builder(String owner, String name, Class<U> type)
      Creates a new property builder.

      This is a shortcut for builder(NamespacedKey, Class).

      Type Parameters:
      U - The type of the value of the property.
      Parameters:
      owner - The name of the plugin that owns this property. This is used to prevent conflicts between properties between different plugins.

      All properties supplied by this plugin are set to Constants.PLUGIN_NAME.

      Properties from other plugins should use the name of the plugin that owns the property.

      name - The name of the property that is used for serialization.
      type - The type of the property.
      Returns:
      The property builder.

    • getAccessLevel

      @CheckReturnValue public int getAccessLevel(ICommandSender commandSender, IStructureConst structure)
      Gets the access level to this property for the given command sender and structure.

      Defaults to 0 if the command sender is not an owner of the structure.

      The returned value is a bit flag whose values refer to the PropertyAccessLevel enum.

      Parameters:
      commandSender - The command sender to get the access level for.
      structure - The structure to get the access level for.
      Returns:
      The access level for the given command sender and structure.

    • getPropertyScopes

      public List<PropertyScope> getPropertyScopes()
      The scopes in which this property is used.

      This is used to prevent side effects of changing the property value. For example, clearing cached values related to the property, such as the animation range when changing the 'blocks to move' property.
